title: Silicon-mediated heat tolerance in higher plants: A mechanistic outlook.
authors: Saha, Gopal; Mostofa, Mohammad Golam; Rahman, Md Mezanur; Tran, Lam-Son Phan
one_liner_zh: 该文综述硅介导植物耐热性的机制，与蛋白质-DNA互作及AI/物理模拟方法完全无关。
abstract: Heat stress, resulting from global warming, is considered one of the major challenges to be addressed for increasing plant survival and productivity worldwide. Although plants have a built-in defense mechanism against heat stress, such strategy seems to be insufficient to counteract heat adversities under extreme temperature regimes. Hence, increasing heat tolerance in plants for sustainable yields is one of the biggest challenges for researchers in the coming decades. Conventional plant breeding approach to enhance heat tolerance has gained some successes; however, more efforts are needed to make plants resilient to heat stress for increasing crop production during ongoing climate change. Thus, exploring 'heat stress mitigation strategies' using cost-effective and eco-friendly approaches may be quick and sustainable alternatives. The use of silicon (Si) and Si-nanoparticles (Si-NPs) in enhancing heat tolerance in plants has recently gained much attention. Application of Si and Si-NPs can assist plants to overcome heat-induced oxidative stress through the acceleration of reactive oxygen species detoxification by modulating the antioxidant systems and regulating transcription of key genes associated with heat stress responses. In fact, molecular rationale behind Si-mediated heat tolerance in plants is largely unknown. In this minireview, we made efforts to understand the mechanistic aspects of heat-induced responses and damages in plants, and possible molecular dynamics of Si-induced heat tolerance in plants. We also highlighted recent advances on how Si induces heat tolerance potential in plants and future perspectives on how Si can contribute to sustainable crop production under the increasing threat of global climate change.
abstract_zh: 由全球变暖导致的热胁迫，被认为是提高全球植物存活率和生产力所需解决的主要挑战之一。尽管植物具有内在的防御机制来应对热胁迫，但在极端温度条件下，这种策略似乎不足以抵御热逆境。因此，在未来的几十年里，提高植物的耐热性以实现可持续产量，是研究人员面临的最大挑战之一。传统的植物育种方法在增强耐热性方面取得了一些成功；然而，在持续的气候变化中，为使植物对热胁迫更具韧性以增加作物产量，还需付出更多努力。因此，探索利用成本效益高且环境友好的“热胁迫缓解策略”可能是快速且可持续的替代方案。近年来，使用硅（Si）和硅纳米颗粒（Si-NPs）增强植物耐热性已引起广泛关注。施用Si和Si-NPs可通过调节抗氧化系统，加速活性氧的解毒作用，并调控与热胁迫反应相关的关键基因的转录，从而帮助植物克服热诱导的氧化胁迫。实际上，Si介导的植物耐热性背后的分子机制在很大程度上尚不清楚。在这篇小型综述中，我们致力于理解热诱导植物反应和损伤的机制方面，以及Si诱导植物耐热性的可能分子动力学。我们还重点介绍了关于Si如何诱导植物耐热潜力的最新进展，以及在全球气候变化威胁日益加剧的情况下，Si如何有助于可持续作物生产的未来展望。
